en: Vintage monochrome postcard depicting the Mosque of Qaitbay with its domed mausoleum and ornate minaret, part of the Tombs of the Caliphs in Cairo. The left side shows the architectural view, while the right side contains handwritten Arabic text. At the bottom, there is printed French text identifying the site, along with a serial number on the left and a small publisher mark and website watermark.
